nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to tech without army production, and avoid neglecting scouting or defense.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and technology while increasing production. Strengthen your ground army as a baseline, and consider expanding to support your heavy economy.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's build or when you reach the early-midgame phase.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a state with heavier production and a clearer army direction, either ground or air, depending on scouting and your tech choices.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is limited at this stage. You have not confirmed their build or pressure intentions, so maintain scouting and be ready to adapt.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early game with a heavy focus on economy and technology. Production is moderate, and your army composition is not yet defined. Defense and expansion are light or uncertain, so you need to balance tech progress with safety.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy tech and economy investment sets up a strong midgame, but you need production to convert that into army. Early expansion supports the economy, but keep an eye on defense.
nodes.title: Early Tech and Economy Foundation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a more defined army composition and heavier production as you move into the early-midgame.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and technology investment, moderate production, and light or uncertain defense and expansion.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-expanding without defense, and avoid neglecting upgrades or tech that will be needed later.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue increasing production and technology. Strengthen your ground army, and consider adding more gateways or tech structures to support your composition.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clearer picture of the opponent's tech or when you reach the midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a midgame state with a defined army style, either ground or air, and continue heavy production and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is still limited, but you may have some scouting. Be prepared for possible early pressure from Zerg.
nodes.own_situation: You have transitioned into the early-midgame with heavy production and technology. Your economy is strong, and you have some Stalkers and Sentries, indicating a gateway-based army. Defense is still light, so you need to be cautious.
nodes.strategic_reason: With a heavy economy, you can afford a strong production base. Stalkers and Sentries provide a flexible core that can transition into various compositions.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Production Ramp
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a more defined army composition, either ground-based with Immortals/Colossus or air-based with Phoenix/Void Rays, based on scouting.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army composition is still undefined but starting to show Stalker and Sentry presence.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; use your army to apply pressure or take map control. Avoid neglecting upgrades.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain your economy. Consider adding tech like Immortals or Colossus to deal with Zerg ground units. Keep producing Observers for vision.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about the Zerg's tech or when you reach the late-midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a late-midgame state with a more powerful ground army or a switch to air if the situation demands.
nodes.opponent_situation: You may have some information about the Zerg's composition, but it's not fully confirmed. Possible pressure from Zerg is a concern.
nodes.own_situation: You have a solid ground army with Stalkers, Sentries, and support units like Warp Prisms and Observers. Your economy and production are heavy, and you have good map vision with Observers. Defense is still light, so you need to be careful about counterattacks.
nodes.strategic_reason: A ground-based army with good vision and support can handle most Zerg compositions, but you need to be ready to adapt if the Zerg goes for air or mass mutalisks.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame army with more advanced tech units like Immortals or Colossus, or transition to air if needed.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is ground-oriented with Stalkers, Sentries, Warp Prisms, and Observers.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid spreading too thin between ground and air; pick a primary composition. Avoid neglecting upgrades or defensive structures.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army and consider adding more tech units like Colossus or High Templar. Maintain your economy and production, and keep your Observer count up for vision.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have confirmed the Zerg's tech or when you reach the late game.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a late-game state with a powerful, specialized army composition.
nodes.opponent_situation: You likely have some information about the Zerg's composition, but it's not fully confirmed. Possible pressure from Zerg is still a concern.
nodes.own_situation: You have a mixed ground army with Zealots, Immortals, and Void Rays, indicating a transition to a more tech-heavy composition. Your economy and production are strong, and you have good vision with Observers. Defense is still light, so you need to be cautious.
nodes.strategic_reason: A mix of ground and air units gives you flexibility, but you need to commit to a composition that counters the Zerg's army. Immortals are good against roaches, and Void Rays can help against mutalisks.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Tech Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game army with a clear composition, either ground-based with Colossus/High Templar or air-based with Void Rays/Carriers.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is ground-oriented with Zealots, Void Rays, Observers, and Immortals.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid expanding without defense, and avoid neglecting army production while expanding.
nodes.decision_direction: Consider expanding to secure your economy, while continuing to strengthen your ground army. Keep production and tech heavy.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have secured additional bases or when you reach the midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a midgame state with a more stable economy and a defined ground army.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is limited, but possible pressure from Zerg is a concern.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground-oriented army with heavy production and tech, but your expansion is light or uncertain. This means you may be relying on fewer bases, which could limit your economy in the long run.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy economy requires multiple bases. If your expansion is light, you may fall behind in income. Secure a third base if possible.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Focus with Light Expansion
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a state with a more solid expansion and a stronger ground army.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is ground-oriented, but expansion is light or uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to air without ground support, and avoid neglecting upgrades or scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue increasing your air army and technology. Consider adding Void Rays or Oracles for additional air power. Maintain your economy and production.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have confirmed the Zerg's tech or when you reach the late-midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a late-midgame state with a powerful air composition.
nodes.opponent_situation: You may have some information about the Zerg's composition, but it's not fully confirmed. Possible pressure from Zerg is a concern.
nodes.own_situation: You have transitioned to an air-based army with Phoenixes as a core unit. Your economy and production are heavy, and you have a mix of ground units for support. Defense is light, so you need to be careful.
nodes.strategic_reason: Phoenixes are strong against mutalisks and overlords, giving you map control. However, they are fragile, so you need a solid ground support.
nodes.title: Midgame Air Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame air army with more advanced air units like Void Rays or Carriers.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is air-oriented with Phoenixes, supported by Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid expanding too greedily without scouting, and avoid neglecting army production.
nodes.decision_direction: Consider expanding to support your heavy economy, while continuing tech development. Increase production to defend against possible early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have secured your expansion or when you reach the early-midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward an early-midgame state with a stable economy and a defined army.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is limited. You need to scout to determine if the Zerg is going for early pressure or a macro game.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early game with a focus on tech and economy, but your expansion is light. This means you may be on one base or a fast expand that hasn't been secured yet.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy economy requires multiple bases. Expanding early can give you a long-term advantage, but you need to defend it.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech Focus with Expansion
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a state with a more solid expansion and a clearer army direction.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and technology, moderate production, and light or uncertain defense. Expansion is light or uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to air without ground support, and avoid neglecting scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue increasing your air army and technology. Consider adding more Phoenixes or transitioning to Void Rays. Maintain your economy and production.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about the Zerg's tech or when you reach the midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a midgame state with a defined air composition.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is limited, but possible pressure from Zerg is a concern.
nodes.own_situation: You have started transitioning to an air-based army with Phoenixes. Your economy and production are heavy, and you have a mix of ground units for support. Defense is light, so you need to be careful.
nodes.strategic_reason: Phoenixes can give you map control and harass overlords, but you need to be careful against anti-air. A strong economy supports this transition.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Air Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a midgame air army with a solid composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is air-oriented with Phoenixes, supported by Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; use your army to take map control or apply pressure. Avoid neglecting upgrades.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army and technology. Consider adding more tech units like Immortals or Colossus. Maintain your defense and economy.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have confirmed the Zerg's tech or when you reach the late-midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a late-midgame state with a powerful ground army and a stable economy.
nodes.opponent_situation: You may have some information about the Zerg's composition, but it's not fully confirmed. Possible pressure from Zerg is a concern, but your defense is strong.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground-oriented army with some Phoenixes for support, and you have invested in defense. Your economy and production are heavy, and you have a solid base defense.
nodes.strategic_reason: A strong defense allows you to play a macro game and transition to a powerful late-game army. Heavy production and tech support this.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Defense and Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame army with a clear composition and possibly a third base.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, production, and technology. Army is ground-oriented with Zealots, Stalkers, and Phoenixes, and defense is heavy.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that prioritizes heavy technology and economy development while keeping production moderate in the early game. The strategic goal is to build a strong tech and economic foundation, then adapt to the opponent's actions with live observation.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / upgrade posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
